title: Figure 42: acoustic pressure magnitude vs radial distance, 1000 Hz in water
description: ANSYS 12.1 line graph of steady-state magnitude of pressure (Pa) as a function of radial distance (m) for 1,000 Hz with 25 elements per wavelength in water. Smooth 1/r decay curve for the uniformly radiating sphere EPW=25, comparing simulation to theory in the BAASS underwater acoustics study.
